open_points.subject: record_change / AcceptBindingChange
open_points.text: It checks no status of the record a lifecycle change updates and sets that change's fields whatever status the record has: the status a change may start from is the caller's rule, and one request ends before the next begins (A18), so no other request can have changed it meanwhile.
open_points.other_text: AcceptBindingChange sets a proposed binding to accepted with accepted_at;
open_points.question: Must AcceptBindingChange require the binding to be proposed, or update it regardless of its current status?

open_points.subject: record_change / DecideApprovalChange
open_points.text: It checks no status of the record a lifecycle change updates and sets that change's fields whatever status the record has: the status a change may start from is the caller's rule, and one request ends before the next begins (A18), so no other request can have changed it meanwhile.
open_points.other_text: DecideApprovalChange sets a requested approval to approved or refused per the = models.OwnerDecision value with decided_at and, for a refusal, writes its refusal_execution as the element's NodeExecution;
open_points.question: Must DecideApprovalChange require the approval to be requested, or update it regardless of its current status?

open_points.subject: record_change / RecordAttemptOutcomeChange
open_points.text: It checks no status of the record a lifecycle change updates and sets that change's fields whatever status the record has: the status a change may start from is the caller's rule, and one request ends before the next begins (A18), so no other request can have changed it meanwhile.
open_points.other_text: RecordAttemptOutcomeChange sets the in_flight attempt's status and concluded_at, writes its concluding NodeExecution, StoredValues and SpooledFiles and sets the approval named by used_approval_id to used.
open_points.question: Must RecordAttemptOutcomeChange require an in_flight attempt, or update the attempt regardless of its current status?

open_points.subject: record_change / ResolveAttemptChange
open_points.text: It checks no status of the record a lifecycle change updates and sets that change's fields whatever status the record has: the status a change may start from is the caller's rule, and one request ends before the next begins (A18), so no other request can have changed it meanwhile.
open_points.other_text: ResolveAttemptChange sets an unknown attempt's status to the AttemptStatus member named like its AttemptResolution (applied or not_applied) and its resolved_by;
open_points.question: Must ResolveAttemptChange require an unknown attempt, or update the attempt regardless of its current status?

open_points.subject: record_change / RevokeChange
open_points.text: It checks no status of the record a lifecycle change updates and sets that change's fields whatever status the record has: the status a change may start from is the caller's rule, and one request ends before the next begins (A18), so no other request can have changed it meanwhile.
open_points.other_text: RevokeChange sets an active grant to revoked with revoked_at;
open_points.question: Must RevokeChange require an active grant, or update the grant regardless of its current status?

open_points.subject: record_change / RecoverInFlightChange
open_points.text: It checks no status of the record a lifecycle change updates and sets that change's fields whatever status the record has: the status a change may start from is the caller's rule, and one request ends before the next begins (A18), so no other request can have changed it meanwhile.
open_points.other_text: RecoverInFlightChange sets one in_flight attempt to unknown with concluded_at, writes its NodeExecution when given and sets used_approval_id's approval to used when given.
open_points.question: Must RecoverInFlightChange require an in_flight attempt, or update the attempt regardless of its current status?

open_points.subject: record_change and spool_file / SpooledFile attempt_number
open_points.text: The module alone assigns, inside the transaction: store positions; the random identities trial_execution_id, binding_id, run_id, approval_id and grant_id, drawn from a cryptographically secure source — a run_id as secrets.token_hex of the imported STORE_RUN_ID_TOKEN_BYTES constant, the form the run spool directories are checked against — and drawn again on a collision, which is a drawn identity for which the row's load operation finds a row; the attempt_number of every record it writes whose model carries one;
open_points.other_text: The attempt_number of file is the element's next number as the caller read it; spool_file assigns none.
open_points.question: Does the module assign the attempt_number carried by each SpooledFile record, or does the caller supply it in the file key?
